newsitem.title: LATVIA: FOREIGN BUYERS DOMINATE TWO-YEAR T-BILL AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN BUYERS DOMINATE TWO-YEAR T-BILL AUCTION.

text.p: Big foreign investors were dominated the first auction of two-year government T-bills on Wednesday while locals were less active, traders said.
"Mainly big foreign investors participated in the two-year paper auction," Maris Vinklers, Hansabank-Latvija head of money market, told Reuters.

"Demand for the two-year T-bills might be subdued on the local market as Latvian banks perhaps are not so sure about their finacial stability in the long term," a forex dealer in a leading commercial bank said.
Most market-watchers expect no immediate effect on the inter-bank market following the launch of the two-year paper.
"I would not see any immediate affects on the over-night market except for a possibility of an inter-bank deposit market developing," a dealer said.
"We now have a longer-term benchmark," he added.
